sections.name: File setup, freshProfile
sections.title: Setup and profile copy
sections.what: Loads the starting profile and the grade calculator, prints a heading, and makes a copy of the profile.
sections.why: Gives the test a fresh starting profile without changing the original.
sections.watch_out: The copy is shallow, so nested values are still shared with the original profile.

sections.name: freshCourses
sections.title: Empty account display checks
sections.what: Calculates the grade with no courses, builds the goal text, prints the key profile values, and checks that the grade and goal show the placeholder and that coins are zero.
sections.why: Confirms a new account looks clean on the academic page.
sections.watch_out: The checks depend on the exact placeholder text, so a wording change makes them fail even if the display is fine.

summary: Checks that a brand-new account shows empty placeholders for the grade average and goal, and zero coins, on the academic page.
purpose: Confirms that a new user does not see invented grades or rewards.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: new accounts should start clean.
how: Load the starting profile and the grade calculator. Copy the profile. Use an empty course list to calculate the grade average. Build the goal text. Print the values and check them against the expected placeholders.
inputs: The starting profile from the seed data and an empty course list.
outputs: Printed values and pass or fail lines.
risks: The check uses a shallow copy of the profile, so nested fields could still be shared. The test uses seed data, not a live account.
debug: If a check fails, compare the printed value with the expected placeholder. Check the grade calculator and the seed profile.
